# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run references`; edit its sources, not this file. -->

This generated reference is for users authoring or reviewing `cockpit.toml`. It is generated from the schema cockpit validates against, so it matches this version. For the handful of tables a typical cockpit sets, start with [Configuration essentials](configuration-essentials.md).

The same schema ships as JSON Schema in [`cockpit.schema.json`](../packages/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json), installed at `node_modules/@b0dea/cockpit/cockpit.schema.json`; point an editor at it for completion and validation as you type.

## Defaults

The values cockpit uses for a key the configuration leaves out.

```json
{
  "cockpit": {
    "siblings_root": "..",
    "guide_cap": 200
  },
  "sibling": {
    "toolchain": "none",
    "guides": [
      "CLAUDE.md",
      "AGENTS.md"
    ],
    "instruction_pointer": false
  },
  "ports": {
    "step": 100,
    "count": 27
  },
  "guards": {
    "hosted_db_hosts": [],
    "vendor_endpoint_hosts": [],
    "protected_branches": [
      "main",
      "master"
    ],
    "allow": [],
    "deny": []
  },
  "mcp": {
    "approved": {}
  },
  "workorders": {
    "attempt_cap": 2,
    "wip_cap": 3,
    "verification_timeout_seconds": 1800,
    "evaluator_timeout_seconds": 900
  },
  "environment": {
    "resettable_volumes": [],
    "generated_host_paths": [],
    "compose_files": [],
    "entrypoint_derivatives": [],
    "install_policies": []
  },
  "surfaces": {
    "overlays": [],
    "harnesses": [],
    "bundles": [],
    "adopted": []
  }
}
```

## Tables

Each section is one TOML table: `[name]` holds one, `[[name]]` repeats. A table accepts only the keys it lists unless its rules below say otherwise. Rules are JSON Schema fragments that relate several keys of the same table. A pattern is a regular expression the value must contain a match for; `^` and `$` in it make it cover the whole value. A type that links to a shape is a table whose keys are listed once, under [Shapes](#shapes).

### `[cockpit]`

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `siblings_root` | string | `".."` |  |
| `guide_cap` | integer | `200` | greater than 0; at most 9007199254740991 |

### `[[sibling]]`

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| `dir` | string |  | required; either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns)) |
| `remote` | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `branch` | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `mount` | string |  | required; either (one of `"always"`, `"host"`, `"none"`) or (pattern `^profile:[a-z0-9-]+$`) |
| `acquire` | string |  | required; one of `"auto"`, `"manual"`, `"none"` |
| `var` | string |  | required; pattern `^(?!(?:DOCKER_\|COMPOSE_\|LD_\|DYLD_\|LIBPATH$\|SHLIB_PATH$\|NODE_OPTIONS$\|NODE_PATH$\|BASH_ENV$\|ENV$\|PATH$\|IFS$))[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` |
| `toolchain` | string | `"none"` | one of `"node"`, `"python"`, `"ruby"`, `"go"`, `"rust"`, `"dotnet"`, `"none"` |
| `gate` | string |  | exactly `"operator"` |
| `host_reason` | string |  | at least 1 character |
| `guides` | array of string | `["CLAUDE.md","AGENTS.md"]` | each item: pattern [P1](#patterns) |
| `instruction_pointer` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `purpose` | string |  | required; at least 1 character |
| `environment_files` | array of table: [`[[sibling.environment_files]]`](#siblingenvironment_files) |  |  |
| `derives` | table: [`[sibling.derives]`](#siblingderives) |  |  |

- Must match `{"oneOf":[{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["none"]}},"not":{"required":["remote"]}},{"properties":{"acquire":{"enum":["auto","manual"]}},"required":["remote"]}]}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}},"required":["host_reason"]},{"properties":{"mount":{"not":{"enum":["host"]}}}}]}`.
- Must match `{"not":{"required":["mount","derives"],"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["none","host"]},"derives":{"required":["generated"]}}}}`.
- Must match `{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"gate":{"enum":["operator"]}},"required":["gate"]},{"not":{"anyOf":[{"properties":{"mount":{"enum":["host"]}}},{"properties":{"purpose":{"pattern":"\\b(?:[lL][iI][vV][eE]|[pP][rR][oO][dD][uU][cC][tT][iI][oO][nN]|[hH][aA][rR][dD][wW][aA][rR][eE]|[sS][iI][mM][uU][lL][aA][tT][oO][rR])\\b"}}}]}}]}`.

| `module` | string |  | required; pattern [P1](#patterns); pattern [P13](#patterns); at most 4096 characters |
| `export` | string |  | required; pattern `^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*$`; at most 128 characters |

### `ports` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; at most 128 characters |
| `host_variable` | string |  | required; pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`; at most 128 characters |
| `internal` | integer |  | required; 1–65535 |
| `host_ip` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` | one of `"127.0.0.1"`, `"::1"`, `"0.0.0.0"`, `"::"` |

### `probe` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `location` | string |  | required; one of `"host"`, `"in-stack"` |
| `service` | string |  | pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; at most 128 characters |
| `cwd` | string |  | required; either (exactly `"."`) or (pattern [P1](#patterns), at most 4096 characters) |
| `argv` | array of string |  | required; 1–256 items; each item: pattern `^[^\x00]+$`, 1–8192 characters |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer |  | required; 1–3600 |
| `provenance` | table: [`provenance` shape](#provenance-shape) |  |  |

- Must match exactly one of `[{"properties":{"location":{"enum":["host"]}},"not":{"required":["service"]}},{"properties":{"location":{"enum":["in-stack"]}},"required":["service"]}]`.

### `provenance` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string |  | required; pattern [P1](#patterns); at most 4096 characters |
| `observed_on` | string |  | format `date`; pattern [P2](#patterns) |
| `kind` | string |  | required; one of `"declared"`, `"measured"`, `"inferred"` |
| `reason` | string |  | required; pattern `\S`; 1–4096 characters |
| `confirmed` | boolean |  |  |

- Must match at least one of `[{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["declared"]}}},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["measured"]}},"required":["observed_on"]},{"properties":{"kind":{"enum":["inferred"]},"confirmed":{"enum":[true]}},"required":["confirmed","observed_on"]}]`.

### `resources` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `memory_mb` | integer |  | required; 6–8589934591 |
| `cpus` | number |  | required; 0.01–92233 |
| `provenance` | table: [`provenance` shape](#provenance-shape) |  | required |

### `toolchain_pins` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string |  | required; pattern [P1](#patterns) |
| `pinned` | string |  | required; 1–256 characters |
| `observed` | string |  | required; 1–256 characters |
| `provenance` | table: [`provenance` shape](#provenance-shape) |  | required |

### `volumes` shape

| Key | Type | Default | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string |  | required; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`; at most 128 characters |
| `purpose` | string |  | required; one of `"dependencies"`, `"product-data"` |
| `install_policy` | string |  | pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]*$` |
| `provenance` | table: [`provenance` shape](#provenance-shape) |  | required |

- Must match exactly one of `[{"properties":{"purpose":{"enum":["dependencies"]}},"required":["install_policy"]},{"properties":{"purpose":{"enum":["product-data"]}},"not":{"required":["install_policy"]}}]`.

## Patterns

Long patterns that several keys share, cited by name in the tables.

| Pattern | Regular expression |
| --- | --- |
| P1 | `^(?!\/)(?![A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*\\)(?:[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+\/)*[^/\x00-\x1f\x7f]+$` |
| P2 | `^(?:(?:\d\d[2468][048]\|\d\d[13579][26]\|\d\d0[48]\|[02468][048]00\|[13579][26]00)-02-29\|\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]\|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|3[01])\|(?:0[469]\|11)-(?:0[1-9]\|[12]\d\|30)\|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]\|1\d\|2[0-8])))$` |
| P3 | `^(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$` |
| P4 | `^(?:(?:25[0-5]\|2[0-4][0-9]\|1[0-9][0-9]\|[1-9][0-9]\|[0-9])\.){3}(?:25[0-5]\|2[0-4][0-9]\|1[0-9][0-9]\|[1-9][0-9]\|[0-9])$` |
| P5 | `^(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,7}:\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,6}:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,5}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,2}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,4}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,3}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,3}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,4}\|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,2}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,5}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,6})\|:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,7}\|:))$` |
| P6 | `^\/(?!\/)(?!.*(?:^\|\/)\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*[\\\x00-\x1f\x7f])[^:]+$` |
| P7 | `^\/(?!\/)(?!\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*\/\.{1,2}(?:\/\|$))(?!.*[%\\?#\x00-\x20\x7f]).*$` |
| P8 | `^(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+localhost(?![\s\S])` |
| P9 | `^[^\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f\uD800-\uDFFF]{1,128}(?![\s\S])` |
| P10 | `^(?:\*\.)?(?=[a-z0-9.-]{1,253}(?![\s\S]))[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*(?![\s\S])` |
| P11 | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9./:_-]*@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$` |
| P12 | `^(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*)(?:-(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\.(?:0\|[1-9]\d*\|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?$` |
| P13 | `^(?!.*(?:^\|\/)(?:\.git\|internal\|node_modules)(?:\/\|$)).+$` |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `sibling[].dir` | `unique` |  |

## Skill size limits

Agent tools load every skill's frontmatter into each session and its entry point whenever the skill is used, so cockpit caps both and keeps the detail in a procedure file the agent reads only when it needs it. The limits come from `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/collection.json`, SHA-256 `738daf2662c9504c7493183159684508075aa0d0d5364ddb3f0f3719c4842eec`.

| Target | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| claudecode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| codexcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| opencode | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| cursor | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| grokcli | frontmatter_bytes | 8192 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |

| Skill entry point | Measured as | Limit | Detail moved to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/cockpit-setup.skill.md` | lines | 11 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/cockpit-explain.skill.md` | lines | 11 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/cockpit-fix.skill.md` | lines | 14 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |
| `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/cockpit-work.skill.md` | lines | 10 | `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` |

The procedure `packages/cockpit/surfaces/skills/procedures/onboarding.md` is read on demand and has no size limit; SHA-256 `9df314793c38f13713f18857aa1083fdbda8c12c32b5a546998536ea578a1afc`.
